sources.decision: Do not promote this internally inconsistent format claim into physical-release or sales evidence.

accessAndLimits: No request to Soridata downloads/captcha routes, owner APIs, private exports, login or transaction endpoints.
K-Towns filtered URL used actual field name/value read from its public form, not a guessed product slug; exact product URL came from the filtered page hyperlink.
Web filtered-category open was inaccessible via connector. An ordinary unauthenticated public HTTP read succeeded without cookie/user-agent/proxy or access-control changes.
First ordinary category HTTP read succeeded but console GBK rendering failed; one second read captured UTF-8 locators. This was an output-encoding repair, not a retry after access denial.
Product web body was an older cached rendering; a normal live HTTP 200 JSON-LD read independently confirmed the same product composition. Unrelated customer reviews were not stored.
Research search results do not establish nonexistence or complete chart coverage. Bounded query completion does not mean these factual gaps are closed.
